snippet.title: Purple Noise Echo - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Purple Noise Echo is a tactical game with a neon-brutalist atmosphere. Emerge from the void into the unknown. Control and free the wandering beings, shape your path and find a way out of this strange world.
Play it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1085540/Purple_Noise_Echo/
or Itch: https://ukioq.itch.io/purple-noise-echo
